notes: Two taḥwīl branches (ح); the names «بهز بن حكيم، عن أبيه، عن جده» are written once, after «نحوه», and are read as the shared tail for both branches.

This tail is a reading of a stretched construction: branch one stops at «أبي», so the join is the text's own convergence claim, not a written «قالا». «نحوه» is a wording remark and is left out. The grandfather is the last link: his «قلت يا رسول الله» is the saying.
